note: Telegram sources. Public broadcast channels only; groups, private chats and users are never read. 'search' runs a keyword search across public channels (the same eight topics as X). 'channel' reads one public channel by username, keeping only messages that match its keywords; add a channel only for an organisation's public broadcast, never a private person's. A source runs only when its status is 'approved' by the NPCC Comms lead.
